summary:
Updated implementation plan reflecting the simplified dual PDF reporting system:
1. Individual Orders Sheet: Clean single row per order across multiple columns (Order ID, Name, Full Mobile, individual size numbers 1,2,3..., Total, Paid status, Amount, and Signature line).
2. Manufacturing Subtotal Sheet: Crystal-clear factory garment cutting and stitching sheet with total orders combined into piece counts per size (e.g. L size: 9 pcs, M size: 6 pcs, etc.) and verification sign-offs.
3. Combined Package (2 in 1): Generates both sheets in one unified document.
